This is a copy of the [Latin Modern Math](https://www.gust.org.pl/projects/e-foundry/lm-math) font, version 1.959, with all of the unnecessary doc files removed.

As per the license terms I will note that you are able to construct a complete version of the original work by downloading linked distribution above and merging it with those files included.

None of the included files have been modified, save for [doc/MANIFEST-Latin-Modern-Math.txt](doc/MANIFEST-Latin-Modern-Math.txt) which has been updated to account for the removed files.

Given the above I'm exercising my right granted by the [GUST Font License](doc/GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt) to deny the request to rename the fonts and associated files, as they are not changed.

As far as I can tell the requirement to do so in such a case is an error on the part of the authors caused by understandably not predicting the need for the use of these fonts on the web.
